review.notes: Machine-drafted ladder unit (adapter-sq@8); awaiting a named native reviewer (npm run review:packet). Invented folk-style tale (boy, cave, snake). The "snake of the house" tradition is a Balkan folk motif: a person should check that the closing line is acceptable and not misleading. Aorist/imperfect mix, direct speech: check "e mbajta pranë meje", "u përgjigj", "u ngrit". No Scripture.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Është natë në fshat dhe jashtë ka mjegull.
sentences.english: It is night in the village and there is fog outside.

sentences.text: Në shtëpinë e gjyshit ka vizitorë: Elira, shoqja e Ardit, dhe nëna e saj.
sentences.english: In grandfather's house there are visitors: Elira, Ardi's friend, and her mother.

sentences.text: Zonja ulet pranë sobës.
sentences.english: The lady sits down by the stove.

sentences.text: Zjarri bën hije të mëdha në mur.
sentences.english: The fire makes big shadows on the wall.

sentences.text: Pas pak vjen edhe fqinji, një mik i vjetër i gjyshit.
sentences.english: Soon the neighbour comes too, an old friend of grandfather's.

sentences.text: Gjyshi sjell lëng molle dhe një tortë.
sentences.english: Grandfather brings apple juice and a cake.

sentences.text: Elira ka sjellë çokollatë nga Tirana.
sentences.english: Elira has brought chocolate from Tirana.

sentences.text: — Në qytet ne hamë çokollatë dhe akullore — thotë ajo. — Këtu ka vetëm lëng molle.
sentences.english: "In town we eat chocolate and ice cream," she says. "Here there is only apple juice."

sentences.text: Gjyshi buzëqesh.
sentences.english: Grandfather smiles.

sentences.text: — Këtu ka diçka tjetër: histori — thotë ai.
sentences.english: "Here there is something else: stories," he says.

sentences.text: Ardi dhe Elira ulen para tij.
sentences.english: Ardi and Elira sit down in front of him.

sentences.text: Mysafirët dëgjojnë.
sentences.english: The guests listen.

sentences.text: — Dikur, në një fshat pranë malit, jetonte një djalë i vogël — fillon gjyshi.
sentences.english: "Once, in a village near the mountain, there lived a little boy," grandfather begins.

sentences.text: Ai ishte i vetëm, sepse babai dhe nëna vdiqën kur ai ishte fëmijë.
sentences.english: He was alone, because his father and mother died when he was a child.

sentences.text: Vdekja e tyre ishte e rëndë për të.
sentences.english: Their death was hard for him.

sentences.text: Gjyshja e rriti në një shtëpi të vogël me çati të ulët.
sentences.english: His grandmother raised him in a small house with a low roof.

sentences.text: Djali kishte një dhi të bardhë dhe e donte shumë.
sentences.english: The boy had a white goat and loved her very much.

sentences.text: Çdo ditë ai luante pranë lumit dhe liqenit, notonte në ujë dhe vraponte në breg.
sentences.english: Every day he played by the river and the lake, swam in the water and ran on the bank.

sentences.text: Në rërë ai bënte lojëra me gurë.
sentences.english: In the sand he played games with stones.

sentences.text: Natën ngjitej në çati dhe shikonte qiellin.
sentences.english: At night he climbed onto the roof and looked at the sky.

sentences.text: Ai rrinte shpesh i vetëm, por ishte i lumtur.
sentences.english: He often stayed alone, but he was happy.

sentences.text: Pranë fshatit ishte një shkëmb i madh dhe i lartë.
sentences.english: Near the village there was a big, high rock.

sentences.text: Në shkëmb kishte një shpellë të ngushtë dhe të ulët.
sentences.english: In the rock there was a narrow, low cave.

sentences.text: Asnjë njeri nuk hynte atje.
sentences.english: No one went in there.

sentences.text: Ishte një zakon i vjetër: asnjë fëmijë nuk shkonte te shpella.
sentences.english: It was an old custom: no child went to the cave.

sentences.text: Njerëzit thoshin se aty jetonte një gjarpër i madh.
sentences.english: People said that a big snake lived there.

sentences.text: Të gjithë kishin frikë nga ai.
sentences.english: Everyone was afraid of it.

sentences.text: Asnjë nuk e kishte parë, por të gjithë e njihnin nga fjalët e njerëzve.
sentences.english: Nobody had seen it, but everyone knew it from what people said.

sentences.text: Një ditë mjegulla ra mbi mal.
sentences.english: One day the fog fell on the mountain.

sentences.text: Mjegulla ishte e trashë dhe e rëndë.
sentences.english: The fog was thick and heavy.

sentences.text: Djali nuk e gjente dhinë e tij.
sentences.english: The boy could not find his goat.

sentences.text: Ai mori një llambë dhe tha: — Do ta gjej!
sentences.english: He took a lamp and said: "I will find her!"

sentences.text: Gjyshja e pyeti: — A nuk ke frikë?
sentences.english: Grandmother asked him: "Aren't you afraid?"

sentences.text: — Jo, gjyshe — u përgjigj ai. — Do të kthehem shpejt.
sentences.english: "No, grandmother," he answered. "I will come back soon."

sentences.text: Ai ishte një djalë trim.
sentences.english: He was a brave boy.

sentences.text: Rruga nuk ishte e lehtë, por ishte e shkurtër.
sentences.english: The road was not easy, but it was short.

sentences.text: Ai eci shumë në mjegull dhe arriti te shkëmbi.
sentences.english: He walked a long way in the fog and reached the rock.

sentences.text: Atje shikoi se dhia hyri në shpellë.
sentences.english: There he saw that the goat had gone into the cave.

sentences.text: Djali nuk mendoi shumë: hyri brenda.
sentences.english: The boy did not think much: he went inside.

sentences.text: Në mur ishte një portë e vjetër.
sentences.english: In the wall there was an old door.

sentences.text: Ai e hapi portën dhe shikoi shkallë të gjata.
sentences.english: He opened the door and saw long stairs.

sentences.text: Hija e tij ishte e madhe, por djali nuk u kthye.
sentences.english: Its shadow was big, but the boy did not turn back.

sentences.text: Shkallët ishin të ngushta, por djali zbriti.
sentences.english: The stairs were narrow, but the boy went down.

sentences.text: Poshtë, pas shkallëve, ishte një dhomë e gjerë.
sentences.english: Below, after the stairs, there was a wide room.

sentences.text: Aty ai shikoi një hije të madhe në mur.
sentences.english: There he saw a big shadow on the wall.

sentences.text: Hija ishte e gjatë dhe e gjerë.
sentences.english: The shadow was long and wide.

sentences.text: Ishte gjarpri.
sentences.english: It was the snake.

sentences.text: Sytë e tij ishin të mëdhenj dhe të lodhur.
sentences.english: Its eyes were big and tired.

sentences.text: — Kush je ti? — pyeti gjarpri.
sentences.english: "Who are you?" asked the snake.

sentences.text: — Jam një djalë dhe kërkoj dhinë time — tha djali.
sentences.english: "I am a boy and I am looking for my goat," said the boy.

sentences.text: Djali kishte frikë, por nuk e tregoi.
sentences.english: The boy was afraid, but he did not show it.

sentences.text: — Je trim që erdhe. Dhia është këtu — tha gjarpri. — Unë jam i vetëm dhe e mbajta pranë meje.
sentences.english: "You are brave to have come. The goat is here," said the snake. "I am alone and I kept her near me."

sentences.text: — Njerëzit kanë frikë nga unë dhe nuk vijnë.
sentences.english: "People are afraid of me and they do not come."

sentences.text: — Jam shumë i vetëm këtu.
sentences.english: "I am very lonely here."

sentences.text: Djali e dëgjoi dhe u ul pranë tij.
sentences.english: The boy listened to him and sat down next to him.

sentences.text: Ai i foli për shtëpinë, për gjyshen dhe për lumin.
sentences.english: He told him about the house, about his grandmother and about the river.

sentences.text: Gjarpri dëgjoi gjithë natën dhe buzëqeshi.
sentences.english: The snake listened all night and smiled.

sentences.text: Në mëngjes mjegulla u ngrit.
sentences.english: In the morning the fog lifted.

sentences.text: Gjarpri e dha dhinë dhe hapi portën.
sentences.english: The snake gave back the goat and opened the door.

sentences.text: Djali u kthye në fshat me dhinë.
sentences.english: The boy returned to the village with the goat.

sentences.text: Ai tregoi gjithë historinë dhe asnjë nuk e besoi.
sentences.english: He told the whole story and nobody believed him.

sentences.text: Por çdo mbrëmje ai shkonte te shpella dhe i sillte gjarprit bukë.
sentences.english: But every evening he went to the cave and brought the snake bread.

sentences.text: Kështu gjarpri nuk ishte më i vetëm.
sentences.english: So the snake was no longer alone.

sentences.text: Ai ishte i vetëm në fëmijëri, por jo në rini.
sentences.english: He was alone in his childhood, but not in his youth.

sentences.text: Të gjithë thoshin se djali ishte trim.
sentences.english: Everyone said the boy was brave.

sentences.text: Vitet kaluan. Në moshën njëzet vjeç djali u martua.
sentences.english: The years passed. At the age of twenty the boy got married.

sentences.text: Jeta e tij ndërroi, por kujtimin e asaj nate e ruajti gjithë jetën.
sentences.english: His life changed, but he kept the memory of that night all his life.

sentences.text: Fëmija i tij u lind në atë shtëpi të vogël.
sentences.english: His child was born in that small house.

sentences.text: Gjarpri ruante portën e shpellës dhe ruante gjithë fshatin.
sentences.english: The snake guarded the door of the cave and guarded the whole village.

sentences.text: Në këtë mënyrë në fshat mbeti një traditë: gjarpri i shtëpisë ruan familjen.
sentences.english: In this way a tradition remained in the village: the snake of the house protects the family.

sentences.text: Gjyshi mbaroi dhe zjarri në sobë u bë i vogël.
sentences.english: Grandfather finished and the fire in the stove became small.

sentences.text: — Këtë histori e di edhe unë — thotë fqinji. — Në fshatin tonë ka një lloj gjarpri që nuk është i keq.
sentences.english: "I know this story too," says the neighbour. "In our village there is a kind of snake that is not bad."

sentences.text: — Unë nuk kam më frikë nga gjarpërinjtë — thotë Elira.
sentences.english: "I am not afraid of snakes any more," says Elira.

sentences.text: — Gjysh, a ka shpellë sot? — pyet Ardi.
sentences.english: "Grandfather, is there a cave today?" asks Ardi.

sentences.text: — Ka, në një vend pranë shkëmbit — thotë gjyshi.
sentences.english: "There is, in a place near the rock," says grandfather.

sentences.text: — Nesër do të shkojmë bashkë, por nuk do të hyjmë brenda.
sentences.english: "Tomorrow we will go together, but we will not go inside."

sentences.text: Nëna e Elirës i thotë faleminderit gjyshit.
sentences.english: Elira's mother says thank you to grandfather.

sentences.text: Ajo merr një pjesë të tortës dhe i jep Elirës dhe Ardit.
sentences.english: She takes a piece of the cake and gives it to Elira and Ardi.

sentences.text: Jashtë mjegulla është shumë e trashë.
sentences.english: Outside the fog is very thick.

sentences.text: Ardi mbyll sytë dhe fle.
sentences.english: Ardi closes his eyes and sleeps.
